commit_message: feat: close the Universal Search v2 quality gate (030)

artifacts.name: UniversalSearch-2.0.0-win-x64.zip
artifacts.role: the release artefact: complete one-dir bundle (CLI + GUI + runtime)

verification.install: verified: install.ps1 on default per-user paths
verification.uninstall: verified: app, shortcut and Explorer verb removed; user data kept
verification.migration: verified: schema 5 (previous release line) -> 9 with documents and FTS rows preserved; downgrade refused
verification.privacy: verified: forget removed 1 document, 1 FTS row, 62 derived rows; source file untouched

search_quality.note: Below the 1.0.0 figures of 1.000 because phase 026 added 5 labelled queries a lexical engine provably cannot answer (synonym, paraphrase, morphological). The failing set is exactly those classes; every answered query still ranks its relevant document first.

benchmark.note: Measured back to back on the same machine at comparable load (50-70%). Run-to-run variance on this host exceeded 2x, so no regression can be claimed or denied for latency; the only load-independent difference is a 12% larger index from the phase 022/026 derived tables. A quiet-machine benchmark is still owed.

signature.note: No code-signing certificate is available. The executables ship unsigned.

known_limitations_summary: No learned semantic embeddings; the semantic layer is local n-gram TF-IDF, optional, fallback-only.
No external APIs, no cloud AI, no telemetry.
hotkey.py is the declared Windows-only exception to the platform-independent core.
No independent code review for phases 026-030.
Inno Setup installer not built or validated in this audit (Inno Setup unavailable); install.ps1 is the validated path.
Manual upgrade only; no auto-updater; index is not synchronised between machines.
manifest_note: This manifest was generated before the release commit and finalised in the following commit, which also adds docs/RELEASE-AUDIT-2.0.0.md. The release tag points at that closing commit.

packaging.layout: one-dir (PyInstaller COLLECT): both .exe files require the sibling _internal/ directory
packaging.verified: extracted to a clean directory: --version, index, search, diagnose self-test and the GUI all work

audit_findings: The GUI logged the raw query text on search failure, contradicting the declared privacy contract. Fixed and asserted by tests/test_release_privacy_contract.py.
The event redactor did not cover field names such as snippet or document_text. Fixed and asserted.
.gitignore did not cover *.db, *.log, *.jsonl, .env or temp files. Fixed; verified that no tracked file became ignored.
Four documents embedded the author absolute temp path. Replaced with %TEMP%.

The first upload attached the two .exe files on their own; a one-dir build does not run without _internal/. Verified by downloading, replaced with the complete bundle, and the bare .exe assets were deleted.
